effects.effect: Each time you finish a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite), you can choose a willing hero ally who finished the [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite) with you. That ally gains the benefits of your [Burgeoning Saint](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.conduit.level-6/burgeoning-saint) feature until you finish another [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite). Additionally, you can spend piety as a [free maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/free-maneuver) to give the hero 1 of their [Heroic Resource](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/heroic-resource) for every 2 piety spent.
